rows.reference_text: Ahmed worked as a Business Analyst on our finance systems upgrade. His requirements documentation was thorough and detailed, and he effectively bridged communication between business and IT teams. He's competent with Visio and JIRA, though his technical depth is limited. Reliable and professional.

Marcus completed his 6-month contract as a Data Analyst competently. He produced accurate reports and dashboards in Power BI, though his SQL optimisation skills were basic. He was professional and met all deadlines. Suitable for junior to mid-level analytical positions.

Kevin completed a 12-month contract as a Network Engineer. His technical knowledge of Cisco and Fortinet was solid, and he completed planned maintenance projects on schedule. His documentation could have been more thorough, and he was occasionally slow to escalate issues. Competent for standard network roles.

Rachel is an outstanding project manager with exceptional organisational skills and stakeholder management. She delivered three major digital transformation projects on schedule and within budget, managing teams of 15+ across multiple departments. Her ability to navigate organisational politics is remarkable. Highly recommended.

Natalie is an excellent Scrum Master and Agile Coach with real expertise in SAFe and Kanban methodologies. She improved our sprint velocity by 40% and created a culture of continuous improvement across teams. Her facilitation skills are outstanding and she's highly respected by all levels of staff.

Sarah is an exceptional senior developer with deep expertise in Java and microservices architecture. During her 4 years with us, she led the migration of our legacy monolith to cloud-native services, delivering on time and under budget. Her technical leadership and mentoring of junior developers has been invaluable. We would be delighted to have her back.

Michael performed well in his role as Business Analyst. He demonstrated solid understanding of requirements gathering and stakeholder management, though his SQL skills required some development. He was reliable, punctual, and contributed positively to team morale. We'd recommend him for mid-level BA roles.

Peter served as IT Support Manager for three years. He maintained 95%+ system uptime, managed a team of four effectively, and reduced helpdesk ticket backlogs significantly. His people management skills are strong, though he sometimes struggles with complex technical escalations. Good all-rounder for infrastructure roles.

She managed our five-site office consolidation project, keeping stakeholders engaged and minimising disruption.
